tasks.title: Buzz

hints.compile: Put the if and else inside the loop's { }, each with its own { } too. Count your { and } : they should match.
hints.lines: Print exactly one line for each number: either the number or Buzz. Use if and else so only one runs.
hints.other: x % 5 == 0 means x divides exactly by 5.

tasks.title: Fix the braces

hints.lines: Line 5 runs every time round the loop, even for odd numbers. Put { } round both lines under the if, so they both belong to it.
hints.compile: Every { needs a matching }. Put { on the line after the if, and } after the second Console line.
hints.other: Both Console lines should be inside the if's { }.

hints.lines: With n = 2 you should get 4 lines. The inner loop runs all the way for each outer lap. Both loops keep going while their variable is <= n.
hints.compile: The inner for, with its own { }, goes inside the outer for's { }. Inside, you can't reuse the name i: call the inner one j.
hints.spaces: + doesn't add spaces. Put them inside the speech marks: " x " and " = ".
hints.other: Use i for the outer loop and j for the inner one: Console.WriteLine(i + " x " + j + " = " + i * j);
